title: Ken Shoulders' ceramic puncture experiment

tellings.quote: Ken Shoulders had an experiment, and please correct me if I'm wrong, where basically he found that electrical pulses into a ceramic would break not break ceramic, but create these punctures in the ceramic that electricity normally wouldn't do.

plain: An experimenter named Ken Shoulders is said to have found that sending electrical pulses into ceramic did not break it, but punched small holes through it, something electricity normally would not do. A guest named Dave Rossi describes the experiment to Michels from memory, asking to be corrected if he has it wrong.
